profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that describes itself as a commercial-stage global developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4. Its site points to the WeRide One universal autonomous driving platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, accumulated real-world operational data, and a set of autonomous driving solutions across the L2 to L4 range. The company says its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries and that it offers five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide trades on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001867729. The company states it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no separately tracked products are recorded for the company.
